# H. — Jonathan Kariuki

> Front ends that load fast. LLM agents that run unattended.
> https://saintlife.dev

## About

Site of Jonathan Kariuki (Kenya), who builds static, accessible front ends, LLM agents with scoped tools and retrieval over the client's own data, and event-driven automation pipelines. Every project listed below has a running demo on this site; none are mockups.

## Projects

Each project has a case page (write-up plus an animated demo) and a separate live build.

### DRAPE — static e-commerce front end
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/drape/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/shop/
- Type: Website
- Summary: 31 SKUs across 6 categories, per-colour product imagery, size selection and a slide-out cart, all client-side. Tailwind CSS and plain JavaScript, no JS framework.

### Ember & Oak — restaurant site
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/ember-oak/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/websites/restaurant/
- Type: Website
- Summary: Mobile-first site with an editorial layout, in-place tabbed menu, dietary tags, gallery, opening hours and a reservation flow with a confirmation state.

### Email Support Agent — retrieval-grounded replies
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/email-support/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/agents/email-support/
- Type: LLM agent
- Summary: Takes support docs and an inbound email, locates the section that answers the question, and drafts a reply restricted to that source, with the citation shown.

### Competitor Analysis Agent — scored report and roadmap
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/competitor-analysis/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/agents/competitor-analysis/
- Type: LLM agent (structured output)
- Summary: Given a company and optional rivals, runs a seven-step analysis and returns a 0–100 score, strengths, gaps and an impact-ranked roadmap.

### Daily Briefing — scheduled pipeline
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/daily-briefing/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/workflows/daily-briefing/
- Type: Automation pipeline
- Summary: Six stages: cron trigger, topic headlines, local weather, two-sentence summaries per story by Claude, emailed digest, run log appended to Google Sheets.

### Email Autoresponder — event-driven Gmail pipeline
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/email-autoresponder/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/workflows/email-autoresponder/
- Type: Automation pipeline
- Summary: No human in the loop: polls Gmail every 30 seconds, parses and filters (drops newsletters and spam), retrieves the matching policy docs, drafts with Claude, replies in-thread, marks the message read and logs the run.

## Capabilities & stack

- Front end: semantic HTML, token-based CSS, plain JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, WebGL shaders, light/dark theming
- Refactors: accessibility fixes, render-blocking asset removal, Core Web Vitals
- LLM agents: Claude API (Anthropic), OpenAI, tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval over client documents
- Pipelines: Gmail API, Google Sheets API, Python, scheduled and event-driven runs with retries and run logs
